answers.how: The toaster spans about 198 px and the cup diameter about 56 px: 198/56 × 0.087.
Near 1 s, the cup moves about 56 px in 0.167 s. Using 0.087 m per 56 px gives 0.522 m/s.
Near 2.25 s, the cup moves about 251 px/s. Multiplying by the cup-derived scale, 0.087/56 m per pixel, gives 0.39 m/s.
